blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: VOC <300 g/L for interior latex (low-VOC). Oil enamel has higher VOC but better durability on metal. Primer is 90% of paint success—don't skip it. Intumescent paint is required for structural steel fire protection, not aesthetic protection. Coverage rate drives project cost and timeline.</Tip>
